title: InvisHider
description: Hides Invis Player's Names in kill messages.
body:
Hides Player Names in kill messages.

i.e 
"bapw was slain by tiytion" turns into "bapw was slain"
there for Hiding invis player's names
if the killer isnt invis, then the death message turns normal, if they are invis, it turns into that.

i got this idea from some random dude in a minecraft server, who said coding a plugin like this is quote "Too Hard", although there **MIGHT** be some bugs in it, i dont doubt, its made, and done

Supports
1.21-1.21.10 (Tested 1.21, .8 and .10, something breaks in .11)

Support : https://dsc.gg/arizaltd
